answer: My most convincing mechanism: verifiers bond a stake before countersigning, and on-ledger proof of an invalid countersignature burns that stake, set far above total epoch rewards. A sybil attacker raising a plume of fake identities gains nothing unless each carries its own bond, so the attack costs locked capital facing total confiscation per fraudulent signature — ferrous collateral, not free usernames. Honest verifiers become a haven for valid traffic, since collusion risks catastrophic loss while rewards stay too small to justify it.
